name: Camp Hawkeye
description_short: Overnight summer camp in Charlestown, NH, with sessions of 2, 4, 6 or 8 weeks. Tuition covers everything: program materials, out-of-camp hikes and trips, overnights, laundry, food and housing.
refund_policy_summary: You must cancel in writing to Jess@camphawkeye.com. Before January 1, all tuition is refunded, including the deposit. After January 1, the deposit is not refunded. After April 1, half of the tuition is not refunded. After June 1, none of the tuition is refunded.
